method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Compilation from legislation.wa.gov.au (mrdoc 49116); compilation table to the Legal Profession Uniform Law Application Act 2022 s 424 (in force 1 July 2022); Reprint 5 as at 10 July 2015; Assisted Reproductive Technology and Surrogacy Act 2025 Pt 17 Div 15 uncommenced and not shown

checks.command: l4 run wills-cases-making.l4; l4 run wills-qa-cases.l4; l4 check wills-qa.l4
checks.result: wills-cases-making.l4: 68 of 68 assertions satisfied; wills-qa-cases.l4: 179 of 179 satisfied; 0 errors and 0 warnings in every file; l4 check wills-qa.l4 succeeds
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

roles: I am making a will, or have made one
I am named in the will of someone who has died, or am their family
I have been asked to witness a will, or have witnessed one

situation_parameters.name: I have married since making the will
questions: Has my marriage revoked my will

situation_parameters.name: my will was made in contemplation of a marriage
questions: Is my will void for the marriage that did not happen

situation_parameters.name: something has happened to my marriage since I made the will
questions: Has my marriage ended under the Act
Has the end of my marriage revoked my will

situation_parameters.name: my will has been revoked
questions: Have I revived my revoked will

deploy_with: daydate.l4 (libraries/daydate.l4 of the 1.6.98 VS Code extension; the b98 jl4-service's own daydate gives an ambiguous __GEQ__)
qa_layer.site_note: Fixed 6 November 2026 after verification on the site's form engine: the validity questions take the routes other than s 8 as one choice, `another route to a valid will`, and no longer the witness-gift fact the baseline does not read, at most 640 combinations, so the form drops them for the roles they are not about (NOTES, QA1); the beneficiary or family's questions take no death situation, the role saying the will-maker has died, and the s 13 question asks a witness the date only if the will-maker has died (QA2).
